title: nb read commands: prime lacks --json, path caps at 20, prime lint count is partial, leads never marked retro
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

- `nb prime --json` is refused; SPEC says every read command takes `--json`.
- `Graph.paths` defaults to `limit=20` (`bin/nb` line 409) and `nb path` prints no "+N more"; SPEC says every path. `has_active_goal` uses a limit of 200 (read only).
- `nb path` prints a one-line lineage summary, not the lineage chain (reviewer-reported, not checked).
- Prime calls `lint(g, full=False)`, which skips three lint rows, so its count can differ from `nb lint`.
- `Graph.retro` (line 476) returns False for a lead, so a lead resting on a retrospective experiment is unmarked in prime, show, context and query.
- Prime line formats differ from the spec example in small ways (type prefix, `1 results`, extra header clause).
